attributes.action: Restore local powers to refer planning applications to elected committees
attributes.additional_details: Planning decisions can permanently change communities, green spaces and wildlife habitats. Local people deserve meaningful opportunities to raise planning concerns before elected councillors in public. We believe national restrictions on committee referrals weaken democratic accountability. Councils should be able to bring applications before a planning committee where local circumstances and planning concerns justify public scrutiny. Local voices must be heard.
attributes.background: Amend the national scheme of delegation in England to remove mandatory officer-only decisions and restrictive committee referral gateways. Restore councils’ powers to set local referral rules, including councillor call-in and triggers based on public objections.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Rescind the Discharge of Local Planning Authority Functions Regulations 2026
